description: Art provenance dossier — validator deep-dive (premium). Returns the x402 URL to GET (402 → PAYMENT-SIGNATURE → delivery). Free to call this tool; payment happens on the URL.

record_id.description: record id from art-search, e.g. art-cma-1959.190 (this or title required)

title.description: work title, exact or close match (this or record_id required)
